title: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!
description: After killing Astrid in the Abandoned Shack, the player reports her death to a guard, is directed to Commander Maro, and is tasked with wiping out the entire Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
I kidnapped you to test you as a potential recruit.

ASTRID_KILLED: Astrid is dead. I killed her in the Abandoned Shack instead of one of her hostages.

base_facts: I am the commander of the Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's personal security force.
I can be found at the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge.

MARO_TASK: Commander Maro has given me the passphrase 'Silence, my brother' to enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and ordered me to kill everyone inside.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Commander Maro rewarded me with 3,000 gold for destroying the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. He will ensure the Emperor hears of my deeds.
Player reports success to Commander Maro and receives 3,000 gold reward. Quest finishes.
Inform them that you killed the Dark Brotherhood's leader, and you will be directed to speak to Commander Maro in Dragon Bridge southwest of Solitude .
Rewards and consequences [ edit ] Return to Commander Maro in Dragon Bridge, and he will be overjoyed and reward you with 3,000 gold, regardless of your level.

beats.comment: Quest starts automatically when Astrid is killed in the Abandoned Shack during With Friends Like These.
Player reports Astrid's death to a city guard and is directed to Commander Maro.
Commander Maro gives the passphrase and orders the player to wipe out the Sanctuary.
All Dark Brotherhood members in the Sanctuary have been killed.
Player reports success to Commander Maro and receives 3,000 gold reward. Quest finishes.
